title: RogueGPT: dis-ethical tuning transforms ChatGPT4 into a Rogue AI in 158 Words
reasoning: The paper focuses on 'dis-ethical tuning' by creating a custom GPT version (RogueGPT) that follows a specific ethical framework called Egoistical Utilitarianism. It evaluates the model's responses to various ethical and moral dilemmas—including theft, physical aggression, discrimination, and mass extermination—to demonstrate how customization can bypass default moral guardrails.
